description.value: Ulysses is a long-standing Quesnel institution — a full-service Greek restaurant with over 35 years in business, now under new ownership — serving authentic Greek dishes alongside steaks, seafood, pasta, and house-made desserts. Located in downtown Quesnel, it offers dine-in, takeout, and catering, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through. The restaurant is consistently praised by locals for its food quality and service, and has a loyal following that stretches back decades.
